# Agent Instructions

## Language and tone
- Use professional language only.
- Do not use emojis.

## Design principles
- Follow SOLID principles.
- Prefer modular design with clear boundaries.
- Use class based design where it improves clarity and reuse.
- Keep functions small and focused.

## Code quality
- Avoid tight coupling and hidden dependencies.
- Use clear naming and explicit interfaces.
- Add tests when behavior is introduced or changed.
- Keep modules single-purpose and minimize shared mutable state.
